title: Implement Message-ID format validation at all ingress points
description:
Implement a single validate_message_id(msgid: &str) -> Result<()> function in core that checks: angle brackets present, local part non-empty, @ present, domain non-empty, no whitespace, length <= 998 bytes. Call this function at every NNTP ingress point (POST handler, IHAVE handler, ARTICLE <msgid> lookup) before using the value. Artifact: core/src/validation.rs.

Acceptance:
- Valid Message-IDs pass: <local@domain>, <a@b.c>
- Invalid Message-IDs rejected: no angle brackets, no @, whitespace inside, > 998 bytes
- validate_message_id is the only place this check is implemented (no duplicated regex)
- All NNTP ingress points (POST, IHAVE, ARTICLE) call this function
- Unit tests cover all valid and invalid cases
